otel.requirement_policy: Keep official requirement levels separate from the required vendor/application profile. All applicable source-known input/output, tool mappings, request/response fields, schema/privacy/bounds, errors and whole-trace lifecycle remain required. Source-absent metadata is explicitly not applicable; do not invent reserved attributes or correlation IDs.

instruments.name: gen_ai.client.inference.duration
instruments.skill_acceptance: Applicable: two actual model HTTP attempts (success and provider_error), positive observed duration; low-cardinality provider/model/operation and applicable error identity.

instruments.name: gen_ai.client.inference.usage.input_tokens
instruments.skill_acceptance: Applicable: provider returns 11 input tokens on success. Record actual usage; missing failed-response usage is zero with unknown modality as the current metric convention specifies, not invented span usage or billing.

instruments.name: gen_ai.client.inference.usage.output_tokens
instruments.skill_acceptance: Applicable: provider returns 7 output tokens on success; same missing-usage distinction.

inference_metric_profile.legacy_compatibility: The captured current main says gen_ai.client.operation.duration should not represent inference. Existing applications may retain source-bound historical instruments for compatibility, but this fresh fixture must not call those names current official inference conventions.
not_applicable: streaming chunk timing: this source has one nonstreaming response
server-side inference timing: this application owns a client request, not model server internals
cache/reasoning token breakdown: not returned by actual response
monetary billing: fixture usage is a local model response, not a price or invoice

agent: operation, provider, agent name and source-known metadata
INTERNAL for in-process agent; CLIENT only for actual remote agent invocation
model: operation/provider/request model and known response metadata
actual model-bound request and produced response messages
source-known parameters/tool definitions/response finish reason/usage only
tool: GenAI mapping: real call arguments plus same-tool input messages; documented OpenInference alternative: input.value
GenAI mapping: real produced result plus same-tool output messages; documented OpenInference alternative: output.value
call ID only when actually supplied by model/framework
retrieval: source query and actual retrieved document list
current GenAI fields plus documented vendor db.operation mapping when applicable; preserve its vendor provenance
errors: ERROR status and sanitized error.type for failure/cancel
no fabricated successful output or usage
delivery: inspect rejected/partial success outcomes separately from local acceptance and real cloud visibility

openinference_alternative.policy: Use exact official enum casing and documented field shape when this alternative is selected. Current OTel fields and vendor-required source content remain separately applicable; no invented database operation or backend recognition claim.

source_attribution: Primary documentation SHA values describe complete captured upstream bodies.
